login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage Keemori invitations, content and operations. Admin accounts are kept apart from customer accounts.
login.securityNote: Repeated failed attempts trigger a temporary lockout. Accounts are issued by an administrator; there is no public sign-up.

errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: Cannot reach the server, please try again later.

notices.password_changed: Password changed. Please sign in again with your new password.

notFound.title: This screen could not be found
notFound.body: The address does not match any screen in the CMS. It may be a typo, or the screen has not been built yet — the sidebar on the left is the full map.

runtime.title: This screen ran into trouble
runtime.body: The last action did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, send the error code below to engineering.

global.title: The page could not load
global.body: The CMS hit a fatal error and cannot be displayed. Please reload the page.

admin.title: Admin

nav.label: Admin navigation
nav.comingSoon: This screen is not built yet
nav.skipToContent: Skip navigation and go to main content

admin.dashboardNote: The revenue and Google Analytics dashboard lives in a separate design and is out of scope for this screen.
admin.backendNote: Every plan limit, ownership rule and payment check is enforced by the backend.

errors.numberMax: That value is above the allowed maximum.
errors.relativePath: The path must start with / (an image hosted by this site).
errors.phoneInvalid: The phone number must have 10 digits and start with 0.

overview.subtitle: Track site traffic, users and invitation creation across the website.
overview.operationsHint: System-wide counts based on the latest available data.
overview.analyticsRestricted: Regular admins can see operational counts. Website traffic and popular templates are limited to super admins.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Customer accounts that buy invitations.
users.deleteConfirmBody: {name} ({email}) can no longer sign in, and this email cannot be registered again. Invitations and orders stay as they are.

settings.title: Link settings
settings.homepageCountHint: Used by the homepage strip; which templates appear is set in “Homepage templates”.
settings.messengerUrlHint: Floating chat button at the bottom right of the public site, and the Fanpage card on the Contact page. Leave empty to hide both.
settings.socialHint: Used in two places: icons in the public site footer, and channel cards on the Contact page (Instagram, TikTok, Zalo). An empty field still shows its footer icon, dimmed and not clickable, but hides its Contact page card; an empty email falls back to the default support inbox.
settings.contactEmailHint: Only used for the mail icon in the footer. The email quoted in the legal documents does not change with this field.
settings.zaloPhoneHint: Shown as the Zalo icon in the footer, the Zalo card on the Contact page and on the Business information page; clicking it opens zalo.me/<number>. Enter 10 digits — spaces are fine.
settings.subtitle: Messenger link, social links and email shown on the public site.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions shown on the homepage. Every entry needs both Vietnamese and English.

templateReviews.title: Template reviews
templateReviews.subtitle: Reviews users submitted for templates in the gallery. They appear immediately with no approval step; this screen is for reading them and removing anything inappropriate.
templateReviews.searchPlaceholder: Search by comment, name or email
templateReviews.confirmDelete: Delete this review? This cannot be undone.

templateTags.title: Template tags
templateTags.subtitle: Tier, style and marketing labels per template. The slug cannot change — it links to the UI and image folder.
templateTags.colorsTitle: Main colors (set when the template is built)
templateTags.noTierMatches: No templates belong to this tier.

templateStats.title: Most viewed templates
templateStats.subtitle: Which catalogue templates guests click into the most, next to how many cards were made from them.
templateStats.noTracking: No template views recorded yet — counting starts from when this release is deployed.
templateStats.countingNote: Each browser counts at most once per template per day.

columnHints.open: Clicked in the catalogue (quick-view dialog) or opened the template page.
columnHints.conversion: Cards created ÷ template opens in the same period.

homepage.title: Featured templates
homepage.subtitle: Pick the templates on the homepage and drag to order them. With nothing picked the homepage falls back to the first templates in the catalogue.
homepage.selectedHint: Drag the handle under a card to reorder, press × to remove. The homepage shows every template here, in exactly this order.
homepage.emptySelected: Nothing picked yet — the homepage is falling back to the first templates in the catalogue. Click a template in the catalogue to add it.
homepage.libraryHint: Templates not on the homepage yet. Click one to add it to the end of the strip.
homepage.libraryEmpty: Every template in the catalogue is already on the homepage.
homepage.unpublishedHint: Unpublished templates never show on the homepage, even when picked.

homepageHero.title: Hero sample card
homepageHero.subtitle: Which card the "View a sample card" button at the top of the homepage links to.
homepageHero.demoCardHint: Leave empty to use the built-in sample. The card artwork in the hero is read from this card too.

coupleShowcase.title: Couples on the homepage
coupleShowcase.subtitle: The "Couples who made a card" strip: which cards appear on the homepage, with which image and in what order.
coupleShowcase.imageSrcHint: A top-to-bottom screenshot of the whole card; the homepage card scrolls through it on hover. Uploads keep a 960px width with no height crop.
coupleShowcase.posterSrcHint: The cover shown on the card at rest, 0.78 ratio (e.g. 960×1231). Leave empty for catalog images to use the poster.avif next to the thumbnail.
coupleShowcase.imagePositionHint: An object-position value, e.g. 50% 0% to show the top of the image.
coupleShowcase.empty: No slots in the strip yet.
coupleShowcase.confirmDelete: Remove this slot from the homepage strip?
coupleShowcase.reorderHint: Drag the handle in the Order column to rearrange the strip. The order is saved as soon as you drop.

picker.search: Search by name or card path…
picker.title: Pick a card
picker.draftHint: Only published cards are listed — drafts have no working link yet.
picker.failed: Could not load the card list. Try again in a moment.
picker.templateHint: Every template has a demo page. Picking one links to /mau-thiep/<template>/demo.

cover.hint: Upload an image or point at a path in the repo (e.g. /images/site/hero-editorial.avif).

siteStats.title: Published stats
siteStats.subtitle: The numbers shown in the stat strip on the home page. These are published figures set by operations, not counts from live data.
siteStats.cacheHint: The public site is cached, so new numbers appear after a few minutes.

cards.title: Created cards
cards.subtitle: Every couple's card history. Pick showcase cards and unlock the couple's names when a customer asks; card content is the customer's private data.
cards.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, slug or email

coupleNames.unlocked: Open for the customer to edit

weddings.title: Wedding calendar
weddings.subtitle: Cards ordered by wedding date, nearest first — so you can send wishes on the day. Only published cards with a wedding date.
weddings.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming weddings in this range.
weddings.emptyPast: No past weddings in this range.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Site traffic, which templates are being picked and cards created.
analytics.dailyHint: Compare visitors with total page views during the period.
analytics.statusHint: All invitations grouped by their current lifecycle status.
analytics.templateHint: The 8 most selected templates, ranked by invitations created.
analytics.googleHint: What our own counter cannot measure: where visitors come from, on which device, and which pages they read. Figures here run lower than the chart above because GA does not measure invitation pages and is blocked by ad-blockers.
analytics.googleNotConfigured: Google Analytics is not connected. Set GA_PROPERTY_ID, GA_CLIENT_EMAIL and GA_PRIVATE_KEY on the backend to show figures here.
analytics.googleError: Could not read Google Analytics data. The figures above are unaffected.
analytics.googleAnalyticsHint: Google Analytics always reads lower than the chart here: it does not measure invitation pages and misses visitors who block trackers.
analytics.visitorHint: Visitors is an estimate the browser reports on its first visit each day; no identifying cookie is set.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A trail of the things that cannot be undone: account deletions, role changes, manual payment matches.

filters.targetIdPlaceholder: Paste a user or order ID…

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your current session and password.
account.rolesHint: Roles are assigned by an administrator in the database. A role change applies from your next action; the permission list on this screen updates after the next session refresh (at most 15 minutes).

password.title: Change password
password.hint: After changing it, every session — including this one — is signed out.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with upper-case, lower-case letters and a digit.

errors.weak: Use at least 8 characters, with upper-case, lower-case letters and a digit.
errors.same: The new password must differ from the current one.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Look up invitation orders and incoming payments.

orders.searchPlaceholder: Order code, email, name, card link, voucher, bank reference…
orders.filterByUser: Show all orders from this customer

unmatched.searchPlaceholder: Transfer content, bank reference or amount

payments.noCode: No order code in the content

matchDialog.title: Match transfer to order
matchDialog.body: This {amount} transfer will be recorded as payment for the order with the code below, and the invitation is published immediately.
matchDialog.hint: The 8-character code the customer saw on the transfer screen. If they only remember their email, look it up in the Invitation orders tab. A wrong match must be refunded manually.

vouchers.title: Discount codes
vouchers.subtitle: Codes customers enter at checkout.
vouchers.hint: A code is applied after the package promotion: list price minus the promotion first, then minus the code. Codes apply to the single package.
vouchers.dialogHint: A code's text cannot be changed once created — deactivate it and create a new one instead.
vouchers.deleteBody: Orders that used it keep their amount and the code text on the receipt. What is lost is the campaign's usage log.
vouchers.publicHint: Eligible codes are available to select at checkout. Partner-exclusive codes are visible only to the store owner.

priceConfig.title: Pricing
priceConfig.subtitle: Price of the custom invitation package, for every customer.
priceConfig.discountHint: Leave empty to run no promotion.
priceConfig.hint: The customer pays the list price minus the package promotion, then minus the voucher (if any). The result is rounded up to a multiple of 1,000 VND.
